$status: PROPOSAL — not yet wired into the orchestrator. The currently-loaded `subjects.json` (panel-mix shape) is unchanged. This file exists to argue the schema before the engine refactor.
$notes: Top-line layer in a Recast cartridge: SUBJECT — what's depicted in the image. Each subject is a noun-phrase (or short scene fragment) that gets composed with a style's prose by the orchestrator. Style decides HOW; subject decides WHAT. Subjects can be plain (just a phrase) or carry slot data (body_region, theme, etc.) when the cartridge needs finer slotting — that's an extension hook, off by default. Intake's job becomes: pick 6 (style, subject) pairs that span the matrix and honor mandatory/forbidden, NOT invent both.
